limitations: Editor diagnostic fixed-input observation only; no physical Steam Deck, standalone GPU or FPS gain inference.
The four time markers are nested/inclusive; never sum them as exclusive HUD cost.
Native LastValue can describe an earlier recorder frame. Snapshot/observer IDs do not identify that recorder sample; per-phase grouping is approximate at boundaries.
Empty recorder values remain missing, never zero. Zero values are reported as native observations, not proof of no work or allocations.
GC Allocated In Frame is whole-frame diagnostic/editor allocation including observer overhead; it does not identify HUD allocations or prove zero-allocation behavior.
TilemapClearCount is a global frame counter, not a HUD-only metric. Broad renderer and wall-frame times include unrelated world/editor work.
Input waits are time-based, so faster/slower runs produce different phase frame counts. Compare fixed action outcomes and phase distributions; do not compare raw sums of marker samples.
Two-row boundary trimming is only a sensitivity view; it is not evidence that profiler samples and explicit frame counters are aligned.
Root must separately retain source revision/diff identity and confirm the same observer implementation. Receipt recipe text alone cannot prove tested source identity.
This old-API route does not exercise the newly added full-history UI or establish subjective readability.
